headline: TWO MIGRATIONS NEVER REACHED THE DATABASE (2026-09-16): digest_items (0011) and pitch_queue (0012) are committed on main but do not exist in the live project — and ops#78 is CLOSED with its table absent. 0013 is recorded under its pre-rename version and 0010 is applied but unrecorded. Filed as ops#348. Root cause is a missing gate: site-engine<->ops and site-engine<->snapshot each have one, the repo<->database seam has none, so a closed issue could leave a missing table behind. Also this session: the email crawler is built (PR #346, green, unmerged) and its extraction is now proven against LIVE content — the first real fetch returned npm-oidc-no-reply@github.com, a bug 28 fixture tests missed because JUNK_LOCALPARTS matched exactly and the localpart only CONTAINED 'no-reply'. It has still never fetched a trades site; this container 403s all egress. Site variety is solved in the engine (site-engine#190 wires a seeded per-lead design selector into leadToConfig) but has never been eyeballed across a batch.
